inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read a Celebrity Zodiac Sign in a Birth Chart
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps for Reading a Celebrity Birth Chart
inline.titleZh: 解读名人出生图的五个步骤
inline.altEn: Five-step guide to reading a celebrity zodiac sign birth chart: date, sun layer, stelliums, behavior, tendencies
inline.altZh: 解读名人星座出生图五步骤：确认日期、区分太阳、寻找相位、对照行为、解读倾向

items.subEn: Start with a publicly reported birth date and flag disagreements rather than filling gaps with guesses
items.subZh: 以公开报道的出生日期为起点，标注不一致之处，不以猜测填补空白

items.subEn: Treat the Sun sign as one chapter, then ask what the Moon and Rising might add or complicate
items.subZh: 将太阳星座视为一章，再追问月亮与上升星座带来何种补充或矛盾

items.subEn: A cluster of planets in one sign or a close aspect often says more about visible character than the Sun alone
items.subZh: 某星座中的行星聚集或紧密相位，往往比太阳单独更能揭示外显性格

items.subEn: Compare placements against documented conduct on court and in interviews; hold interpretations loosely if nothing lines up
items.subZh: 将星盘配置与赛场及采访中有据可查的行为对照，若无对应则保持宽松解读

items.subEn: Frame every placement as something that may surface under the right conditions, never as a fated result
items.subZh: 将每个配置理解为在特定条件下可能显现的倾向，而非命中注定的结果

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Ben Shelton's Zodiac Sign at a Glance
inline.titleEn: Four Layers of Ben Shelton's Birth Chart
inline.titleZh: 本·谢尔顿出生图的四个解读层次
inline.altEn: Four layered readings of Ben Shelton zodiac sign: Libra Sun, Moon sign, Rising sign, and dominant aspect
inline.altZh: 本·谢尔顿星座的四层解读：天秤座太阳、月亮星座、上升星座与主导相位

items.subEn: Anchors core identity in balance and poise; air element, Venus-ruled, with 7th-house themes of relating
items.subZh: 将核心身份锚定于平衡与沉着；金星主宰的风元素，带有第七宫的关系主题

items.subEn: Adds the emotional and instinctive layer; tied to its element and the 4th-house theme of private life
items.subZh: 增添情感与本能层面；与其元素及第四宫的私密生活主题相连

items.subEn: Shapes first impressions and outward style; set by birth time, colored by the 1st-house theme of approach
items.subZh: 塑造第一印象与外在风格；由出生时间决定，受第一宫呈现方式主题影响

items.subEn: Highlights a recurring tension or strength; reflects the elements of the planets involved
items.subZh: 揭示反复出现的张力或优势，体现相关行星所属元素的性质
